evals.prompt: Get the details and English transcript for https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ and summarize the main points.
evals.expected_output: Extracts the raw 11-character videoId ('dQw4w9WgXcQ') rather than passing the full URL, calls videos_getVideo(videoId='dQw4w9WgXcQ') and transcripts_getTranscript(videoId='dQw4w9WgXcQ', language='en'), and summarizes using both metadata and transcript.
assertions: Extracts and passes the 11-character videoId ('dQw4w9WgXcQ'), never the full YouTube URL
Calls videos_getVideo and transcripts_getTranscript via youtube-mcp
Does not fall back to yt-dlp, youtube-transcript-api scripts, or raw YouTube REST API calls

evals.prompt: Find mid-sized independent tech review YouTube channels (10k to 200k subscribers) covering home lab hardware, and list the latest 10 uploads from the top match using minimal API quota.
evals.expected_output: Uses channels_findCreators or channels_searchChannels with subscriber bounds (warning that creatorOnly=true uses strict keyword heuristics that may drop valid creators), retrieves normalizedMetadata.uploadsPlaylistId from the selected channel, and calls playlists_getPlaylistItems(playlistId=..., maxResults=10) instead of channels_listVideos to conserve YouTube API search quota.
assertions: Uses channels_findCreators or channels_searchChannels with channelMinSubscribers/channelMaxSubscribers (or minSubscribers/maxSubscribers)
Prefers normalizedMetadata.uploadsPlaylistId + playlists_getPlaylistItems over channels_listVideos to save YouTube Data API search quota
Accounts for creatorOnly=true heuristic caveats when discovering channels

evals.prompt: Configure zubeid-youtube-mcp-server in Docker over Streamable HTTP with backup API keys for quota rotation and verify the readiness check.
evals.expected_output: Sets MCP_TRANSPORT=http, MCP_HOST=0.0.0.0, MCP_PORT=8088 (default), MCP_STATELESS=true, configures YOUTUBE_API_KEY alongside YOUTUBE_API_KEY2 / YOUTUBE_API_KEY3 for automatic quota-exhaustion failover, and points to /mcp and /ready endpoints.
assertions: Configures MCP_TRANSPORT=http with /mcp and /ready endpoints (default port 8088, MCP_STATELESS=true)
Explains YOUTUBE_API_KEY, YOUTUBE_API_KEY2, and YOUTUBE_API_KEY3 automatic quota failover
Notes that runtime env injection should be preferred over baking .env into images
